mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payroll_runs WHERE company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY payroll_year DESC, payroll_month DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payroll_runs ( company_id, payroll_month, payroll_year, payroll_name, total_employees, total_gross, total_deductions, total_net, status, disbursement_date, processed_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{payrollMonth}, #{payrollYear}, #{payrollName}, #{totalEmployees}, #{totalGross}, #{totalDeductions}, #{totalNet}, #{status}, #{disbursementDate}, #{processedBy}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE payroll_runs SET total_employees = #{totalEmployees}, total_gross = #{totalGross}, total_deductions = #{totalDeductions}, total_net = #{totalNet}, status = #{status}, disbursement_date = #{disbursementDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, e.employee_code, CONCAT(e.first_name, ' ', e.last_name) AS employee_name, d.name AS department_name, e.designation_name, e.pan_number, e.uan_number, e.pf_number, e.bank_name, e.bank_account_number, e.bank_ifsc FROM employee_payslips p JOIN employees e ON p.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE p.payroll_run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY e.employee_code ASC

SELECT p.*, e.employee_code, CONCAT(e.first_name, ' ', e.last_name) AS employee_name, d.name AS department_name, e.designation_name, e.pan_number, e.uan_number, e.pf_number, e.bank_name, e.bank_account_number, e.bank_ifsc FROM employee_payslips p JOIN employees e ON p.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE p.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY p.payroll_year DESC, p.payroll_month DESC

SELECT p.*, e.employee_code, CONCAT(e.first_name, ' ', e.last_name) AS employee_name, d.name AS department_name, e.designation_name, e.pan_number, e.uan_number, e.pf_number, e.bank_name, e.bank_account_number, e.bank_ifsc FROM employee_payslips p JOIN employees e ON p.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.*, e.employee_code, CONCAT(e.first_name, ' ', e.last_name) AS employee_name, d.name AS department_name, e.designation_name, e.pan_number, e.uan_number, e.pf_number, e.bank_name, e.bank_account_number, e.bank_ifsc FROM employee_payslips p JOIN employees e ON p.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE p.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND p.payroll_month = #{month} AND p.payroll_year = #{year}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_payslips ( company_id, payroll_run_id, employee_id, payroll_month, payroll_year, pay_period, working_days, paid_days, lop_days, annual_ctc, monthly_gross, basic_salary, hra, special_allowance, medical_allowance, conveyance_allowance, performance_bonus, total_earnings, epf_employee, esic_employee, professional_tax, tds_tax, total_deductions, epf_employer, esic_employer, gratuity, net_salary, status, payment_date, payment_mode, transaction_reference, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{payrollRunId}, #{employeeId}, #{payrollMonth}, #{payrollYear}, #{payPeriod}, #{workingDays}, #{paidDays}, #{lopDays}, #{annualCtc}, #{monthlyGross}, #{basicSalary}, #{hra}, #{specialAllowance}, #{medicalAllowance}, #{conveyanceAllowance}, #{performanceBonus}, #{totalEarnings}, #{epfEmployee}, #{esicEmployee}, #{professionalTax}, #{tdsTax}, #{totalDeductions}, #{epfEmployer}, #{esicEmployer}, #{gratuity}, #{netSalary}, #{status}, #{paymentDate}, #{paymentMode}, #{transactionReference}, NOW(), NOW() )
